projects.title: CloudOps: Automated Cloud Infrastructure & Progressive Delivery
projects.subtitle: 5-Phase DevOps Project: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, Argo Rollouts & Grafana
projects.problemStatement: Bridging the gap between software engineering and modern DevOps requires end-to-end hands-on experience in cloud provisioning, containerized CI/CD, progressive canary rollouts, observability, and disaster recovery.
projects.solutionArchitecture: Built an end-to-end, cost-conscious cloud platform across 5 modular phases: (1) Modular AWS VPC & EKS in Terraform with S3 backend locking; (2) Hardened Python microservice with GitHub Actions CI/CD to GHCR; (3) Prometheus, Loki, Promtail, and Grafana datasources-as-code; (4) Argo Rollouts canary traffic shifting (25% → 100%) on kind; (5) Velero & in-cluster MinIO backup executing full namespace restoration in 17 seconds.
architectureHighlights: Modular Terraform VPC across 2 AZs with encrypted S3 state and native locking (use_lockfile)
Hardened non-root Python microservice with automated GitHub Actions CI/CD to GHCR
Prometheus metrics scraping and single-binary Loki log streaming with Grafana dashboards
Argo Rollouts automated multi-step Canary traffic shifting with rollback verification
Velero disaster recovery with 100% namespace restoration validated in 17 seconds

projects.title: Enterprise Release Checksum & Systems Automation Engine
projects.subtitle: Parallelized Shell Scripting for Oracle BRM Releases at Mobily Infotech
projects.problemStatement: Manual release verification for bi-weekly Oracle BRM releases involved over 100 repetitive manual CLI steps to calculate and verify checksums across billing packages, leading to operational toil and risk of human error.
projects.solutionArchitecture: Engineered parallelized shell scripts utilizing time-based filtering and background jobs to automate checksum operations and artifact integrity verification across distributed environments.
architectureHighlights: Parallelized background workers executing concurrent checksum validations
Time-based filtering mechanism targeting exact release packages automatically
Eliminated 100+ manual CLI steps per release cycle while reducing error risk
Standardized operational procedure adopted across engineering operations

projects.title: Oracle BRM Partitioned Database Diagnostics & SQL Suite
projects.subtitle: Production Systems Support & Anomaly Detection at Mobily Infotech
projects.problemStatement: Enterprise billing platforms handle complex transaction datasets where query slowdowns or database exceptions require fast diagnostic tracing to prevent service disruption.
projects.solutionArchitecture: Authored and executed analytical Oracle SQL queries on large partitioned databases to support capacity management, trace application telemetry, diagnose exceptions, and assist in drafting technical summaries for incident resolution.
architectureHighlights: Analytical SQL queries on partitioned tables for rapid exception diagnosis
Proactive capacity tracking to detect database bottlenecks in advance
Integrated Unix command-line utilities for error log correlation
Supported L2/L3 teams with clear diagnostic information to reduce MTTR

projects.title: Hardened Python Microservice & Container CI/CD Pipeline
projects.subtitle: Secure Containerization, Health Probes & GitHub Actions GHCR Workflows
projects.problemStatement: Standard containers running as root with mutable tags create security risks and unpredictable deployments in Kubernetes environments.
projects.solutionArchitecture: Developed a containerized Python microservice implementing non-root user execution, multi-stage Docker builds, health endpoints (/healthz), and GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows publishing immutable commit-SHA tagged images to GHCR.
architectureHighlights: Multi-stage Docker builds minimizing image size and attack surface
Non-root user execution conforming to Kubernetes security best practices
Built-in health probes (/healthz) for liveness and readiness checks
Automated GitHub Actions pipeline with build verification and GHCR publishing
